description: Template for annotating passage-level graded relevance for nDCG and multi-target retrieval evaluation.

relevance_scale_definition.0: Irrelevant - Off-topic, unrelated Act or procedural stage
relevance_scale_definition.1: Marginally Relevant - Provides peripheral or general context
relevance_scale_definition.2: Relevant - Directly addresses substantive facets or criteria
relevance_scale_definition.3: Highly Relevant - The primary statutory provision or core operative section

justification: Explains why this passage is relevant or irrelevant to the query.
